name: Gunsmith
desc:
The Gunsmith is an NPC who is found in the Armory of Guild Bases. They can be hired for 1,000. They have the exact same function as [Mag](entity:mag) but inside of your guild base.

Their main use is to produce Bullet Casings by converting two hundred Bullets into specialized Bullets using Ores for a price of up to 40, giving them different properties and playstyles.
